description: Chain fold, `X.finally(c)`: throwing if X or `c` is. `finally` discharges nothing, so a rejecting head survives it.

diagnostics.message: Awaiting `rejects().finally(done)` escapes this `@nothrow` function: the call that produced it has a body that was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that producer non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.

Awaiting `resolves().finally(dirty)` escapes this `@nothrow` function: a handler in the chain has a body that was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try { await … } catch`, or make that handler non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
